game_concept: A speed quiz set in Mt. Pyre – Crater Lake Edge, the edge of a glowing crater: the lava scout must handle lava imps while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Compound Combo: Chain +=, -=, *= updates to hit a target value exactly.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Crater Lake Edge: the edge of a glowing crater
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
player_objective: Read score. Display Pass when score ≥ 44; otherwise display Retry. Check below, equal to and above the boundary. This is an exercise cutoff, not the adaptation rule. Test dataset 2: {'score': 43}; {'score': 45}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Compound Combo' (Week 2 slot 12), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Crater Lake Edge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Collect 260 points of cooling flasks by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
source_lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 260, or lives reach 0.
source_game_title: Compound Combo – Crater Lake Edge Rush
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
